title: Best Black Friday cycling deals 2026
content:
Cyclist
Best Black Friday cycling deals 2026

Now Black Friday is upon us, there’s a host of deals available on all things bike, so this is a great time to refresh your cycling inventory and replace items that have seen better days after another summer of riding. It’s also an opportunity to upgrade your setup so that you’re ready for a great year of cycling in 2027.

Finding the best Black Friday deals can be a chore, but here at Cyclist we’ve done the hard work for you, searching out the bargains that we’d choose ourselves in the pre-Christmas sales.

Read on for our pick of the 2026 Black Friday deals.

Giant Defy SL 1

Was £8,499, now £4,999 at Giant

Giant has a hefty discount on a range of its top-rated road bikes, so you can pick up the SRAM Force AXS-equipped Defy Advanced SL 1 with £3,500 off the standard price. The spec also includes Giant SLR 1 36mm carbon wheels with Cadex 32mm tyres.

If you want to get flashy, the pro-level TCR Advanced SL 0 with either Dura-Ace or Red AXS is priced down from £11,999 to £5,999 and there are also discounts on the last-generation Propel Advanced SL 0 aero bike. When tech editor Sam Challis reviewed the Defy, he gave it it an Editor’s Choice award, concluding it was “perhaps not the bike you want, but almost certainly the bike you need”, helping you to make up your mind.

Le Col Pro Jersey

Was £145, now £75 at Le Col

Le Col has its entire range discounted for Black Friday, so you can pick up the Pro jersey for just £75. It’s available in a full range of sizes in two of the four colours. The Pro Bib Shorts are even more of a bargain, with all sizes available in three colour combinations and all priced down to £130 from £220.

When we reviewed the Pro kit, we reckoned it was comfortable, with a straightforward design. It’s less pro than most pro kit, so it’s better suited to amateurs riding on UK summer days than WorldTour racers cresting the Ventoux in July.

Zefal Sense waterbottle

Was £11, now £5.99 at Cyclestore

If your water bottles are a little tired, having been slurped from through the summer heatwave, now might be time for a bottle refresh. Cyclestore has a range of bottles discounted for Black Friday, including the ever-popular Elite Fly Tex and Camelbak Podium, both in a range of sizes.

We’d opt for Zefal’s Sense bottle though, not just because it has a larger discount, but because it’s available with a No Mud cap (as are Elite’s bottles), so you can avoid drinking road grot from damp, muddy roads this winter.

Scicon Aerocomfort 3.0 travel bag

Was £999, now £459.54 at Scicon (bike not included)

Get ready to fly/drive/train to the spring training camp with a 50%-plus discount on Scicon’s Aerocomfort 3.0 soft case bike bag. Its internal stand holds your bike in place, without needing to take a wrench to your bars and seatpost, so you’ll get riding much more quickly when you arrive. There’s plenty of padding to baggage handler-proof your Pinarello (other bike brands are available) and it’s easy to wheel around thanks to quality rollers.

Scicon has Black Friday price drops on its gravel and tri bike bags too, as well as its Pog-alike sunnies. There are two-for-one offers on some styles and an extra 10% off at checkout and free shipping on orders over £190.

SunGod sunglasses

Buy one, get one free

SunGod has a buy one, get one free offer across a wide range of its sunglasses for Black Friday, including popular cycling styles such as the frameless Airas and half-frame Vulcans and Velans 2. We’ve been impressed by SunGod’s lens quality and low weight when we’ve reviewed the brand’s sunnies, plus there are loads of customisation options and lens tints, including its Iris photochromics and team edition choices.

Browse SunGod’s Black Friday page for more options, including styles for running and ski goggles, as well as its cycling glasses.

Zwift Ride with Kickr Core 2

Was £1,099.99, now £899 at Zwift

Zwift has over £200 off the price of the Zwift Ride smart frame with a Kickr Core 2 turbo, offering a turnkey entry into the world of indoor cycling, with a free 14-day trial of its Zwift Plus premium tier included.

There’s a discount too on the Wahoo Kickr Core 2, which is priced down to £399.99 from £499.99, while the Zwift Cog and Click upgrade kit, allowing you to install virtual shifting on your trainer has a huge markdown. It’s usually £49.99, but you can pick it up for just £12.50, with all Zwift Black Friday offers ending at midnight on Monday 30 November.

Wahoo Elemnt Roam 3

Was £399.99, now £349.99 at Wahoo

Wahoo has a Black Friday discount on its cycling computers, including the Roam, its mid-format touchscreen device. Wahoo has updated its internals, added connectivity to a range of biosensors and switched from button-only to a touchscreen interface, so it’s a full-featured GPS that won’t swamp your handlebars.

You can also buy the Elemnt Ace, which includes Wahoo’s innovative wind speed sensor, for just £10 more or scale down to the Elemnt Bolt 3, saving £100. There are sale prices for Black Friday across a range of Wahoo’s other hardware, including £132.50 off the Kickr Climb gradient simulator and the Kickr Bike Pro, with £700 off.

Hunt 44_46 Aerodynamicist wheelset

Was £899, now £539.40 at Hunt Wheels

The Aerodynamicist range is Hunt’s mid-priced wheelset and available in a range of depths, all with 25% off this Black Friday, with Hunt applying an extra 10% on top of its already discounted prices for Black Friday.

The Hunt 44_46 Aerodynamicist is the middle depth option and carries over tech from the pricier Limitless wheelsets. With hooked beads, there’s wide tyre compatibility, while Hunt points out that the 22mm internal width allows owners to fit tyres from 25mm up. At under 1,350g for the steel spoked wheels, it helps keep the weight down too.

Cyclist staff writer Laurence Kilpatrick was impressed by the carbon spoked version of the wheels when he reviewed them earlier this year, rating them great value.

We have a whole range of Hunt deals on our dedicated Hunt Black Friday sale page. Hunt says that its most popular deals are already selling out though, so if you have your eye on a wheel upgrade, you might want to act fast.

Scott Shield Light Sensitive Sunglasses

Were £110, now £77 at Scott Sports

Scott’s Black Friday deals include these large lens Shield photochromic sunglasses, available either with a black or white frame. They feature Scott’s gold chrome mirrored lens, which darkens from Cat 1 to Cat 3, so they’ll handle the typical range of light conditions across different seasons. Single tint Shields are discounted as well.

There’s a whole range of other discounts in Scott’s Black Friday sale, from clothing to Syncros Capital wheels. With the brand’s broad range of sports, there are discounts on trail running and ski kit too.

Specialized S-Works Aethos 2

Was £11,499, now £8,999 at Sigma Sports

Sigma Sports has discounts on a wide range of road and gravel bikes including the Cervelo S5 and this top spec S-Works Aethos 2 in a range of sizes. Lower Aethos 2 specs are discounted too, although in a more limited range of sizes.

Laurence Kilpatrick rated the S-Works Aethos 2 when he reviewed the bike, not least its 6kg weight in size 56.

Sigma Sports has Black Friday deals on a wide range of clothing, components and accessories too, so chances are that if you’re looking for something specific, Sigma will be offering a Black Friday discount.

Ribble Ultra-Grit Force XPLR AXS

Was £4,449, now £3,999 at Ribble Cycles

Ribble’s Black Friday deals change each week, so if you’re looking for a new gravel race bike, now’s your chance. The Ultra-Grit is ridden by the Ribble Outliers pro race team and features aero tube profiles, a one-piece cockpit and in-frame storage. In this spec, it’s kitted out with SRAM’s 13-speed Force XPLR AXS groupset and Vision SC45 wheels. The frame is suspension fork-compatible and you can upgrade to a RockShox Rudy Ultimate XPLR fork, as well as Zipp 303 XPLR SW wheels in Ribble’s bike builder.

Ribble’s Black Friday deals extend to a wide range of its other road and gravel bikes too. It’s now added its titanium models including the Allroad Ti and Ribble guarantees that, should the price drop later in the Black Friday sale, it will refund the difference.

Garmin Rally XC200 SPD dual-sided power meter

Was £959.99, now £599.99 at Tredz

The Garmin Rally power meter pedals are discounted at Tredz, offering you dual-sided power measurement for Shimano SPD gravel cleats for not much more than the list price of the single sided power meter. They have swappable bodies, so you can change to an SPD-SL or Look Keo power meter for the price of the upgrade kit.

Tredz has over 1,000 products discounted for Black Friday, including Garmin smartwatches and cycling computers and Garmin Tacx smart trainers, so it’s a great place to browse for your replacements and upgrades.

Castelli Sorpasso Pro Bibtights

Were £220, now £176 at Castelli

Not technically a Black Friday sale, as it finishes on 16th November, but Castelli has discounts on its cold weather essentials, so you can gear up with its jackets, base layers, socks and other cold weather gear for both men and women riders.

The Sorpasso Pro bib tights are Castelli’s top spec winter legwear, with its Progetto X2 Air seat pad, zipperless ankles and lay-flat bibs, as well as the reflectives to keep you safer on your winter rides.

Tacx Neo 2T smart trainer

Was £860, now £689 at Balfe’s Bikes

Tacx’s high tech Neo 2T trainer is discounted at Balfe’s Bikes for Black Friday and is available with either a conventional 11-speed cassette or Zwift Cog and Click for the same price. With 2200 watts resistance, it’s plenty powerful enough, it folds away neatly and can mimic a 25% incline. It’s quiet too, that is unless you want to simulate riding cobbles in preparation for an early season Belgian sportive.

It’s one of a wide range of cycling equipment and bikes discounted in Balfe’s Bikes’ Black Friday sale, including turbo trainers and indoor bikes from Elite, Wahoo and Wattbike.

Muc-Off Pressure Washer Starter Kit

Was £120, now £84.99 at Decathlon

If washing down your bike after a winter ride feels a chore, Muc-Off’s pressure washer can speed things up. It comes with a range of lances, including one that allows you to attach a bottle of Muc-Off’s bike cleaner and spray your bike with grime-busting foam, making bike cleaning much more fun.

Decathlon has a tasty discount on the Muc-Off Pressure Washer Starter Kit, which comes with all the lances you could need and is housed in a Muc-Off branded dry bag, making it easy to carry around. There’s a range of other cycling equipment and bikes in Decathlon’s Black Friday sale too.
